title: The Wilmington Papers
tagline: Seven dinners in Wilmington, North Carolina. Transcribed without consent, catalogued without mercy. Nothing was resolved.

cold_cases.title: Cold Cases
cold_cases.dek: {questions} questions asked and never answered. {loops} loops left open. No one is working on any of this.

canon.title: Canon
